description: This file defines the PortGuardian actor which manages network port monitoring and control for the OpenClaw application. It includes logic for recording port listenings, inspecting active listeners, terminating unexpected processes, and generating reports on port usage, particularly in relation to gateway connections.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor responsible for monitoring, recording, and managing network ports used by the application, including detecting listeners, terminating unexpected processes, and generating status reports.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Record
classes.description: Data structure representing a record of a network port listening process, including port number, process ID, command, mode, and timestamp.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Descriptor
classes.description: A structure to hold information about a process listening on a port, including optional executable path.

classes.name: PortGuardian.PortReport
classes.description: Represents the status of a port, including expected service description, status (ok, missing, interference), and associated listeners.

classes.name: PortGuardian.ReportListener
classes.description: A view model of a listener process with additional metadata such as whether it is expected and user information.

classes.name: PortGuardian.Listener
classes.description: Internal structure for holding details about a network listener process

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Scans specified ports, logs their status, and kills unexpected processes based on mode.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a port listen event with process ID, command, and mode.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes a record of a process based on its PID.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides details about the process listening on a specified port.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Generates reports on current port status and listening processes.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks if the gateway service is healthy on a specified port.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Checks if a port is currently being listened to, optionally filtering by process ID.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieves current active listeners on a specified port.

methods.name: readFullCommand
methods.description: Reads the full command line of a process given its PID.

methods.name: parseListeners
methods.description: Parses the output of 'lsof' to extract listener process information.

methods.name: buildReport
methods.description: Builds a port report based on current listeners and operational mode.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Determines the executable path of a process given its PID on Darwin systems.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process given its PID.

methods.name: isExpected
methods.description: Determines whether a process listener corresponds to an expected service based on command matching.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks gateway health status if applicable based on current listeners and mode.

methods.name: loadRecords
methods.description: Loads port records from a JSON file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current port records to a JSON file.
